settings.heading: Returns & Refunds
settings.subtitle: Shop with confidence. Local returns and refunds handled by our Doha team.

settings.heading: Returns, Refunds & Cancellations
settings.content: Report a damaged, defective or incorrect item within 24 hours of delivery for a free replacement, repair or refund. Items still sealed in their original packaging may be returned within 48 hours of delivery, assessed case by case. Once a smart-lighting or electronic product has been opened or used we cannot accept a change-of-mind return.

settings.title: Contact us
settings.text: Message our team with your order number and a brief description of the issue. Photos or a short video help us process it faster.

settings.title: Pack it up
settings.text: Keep all packaging, manuals and accessories intact — these are needed to process the claim.

settings.title: Get your refund
settings.text: Once the item is received and quality-checked, we refund your original payment method within 7 to 10 working days.
